violations.text:
Carbon dioxide/helium tanks not adequately secured.
Manager moved behind chain

Nonfood-contact surface soiled with grease, food debris, dirt, slime or dust.
Hood filters above grill have buildup

Handwash sink used for purposes other than handwashing.
Used to store pitcher. Pitcher was removed

No measuring device available for measuring utensil surface temperature when using hot water as sanitizer in a dishmachine.
Provided image on what to purchase

Required employee training expired for some employees. To order approved program food safety material, call DBPR contracted provider: Florida Restaurant and Lodging Association (SafeStaff) 866-372-7233.
Pamela, Joann
Ice buckets not stored inverted or in a protected manner.

Raw animal food stored over/not properly separated from ready-to-eat food.
Raw beef over tomato sauce

Self-service salad bar/buffet lacking adequate sneezeguards or other proper protection from contamination.
Cookies on table. Manager moved under sneeze guard

Time/temperature control for safety food cold held at greater than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Buffet line- sour cream (51F - Cold Holding); melon (51F - Cold Holding) in service for 1 hour.
Manager added more ice.
